units.source_text: 紫夫人近年来有一私愿：请僧人书写《法华经》一千部。

en.t: In recent years Lady Murasaki had cherished a private wish: to have monks copy one thousand volumes of the Lotus Sutra.

units.source_text: 此时急于要实行这供养，就在她当作私邸的二条院内举行。

en.t: Now eager to carry out this offering, she held the ceremony at Nijo-in, which she used as her private residence.

units.source_text: 七僧的法服，各按品级赐赠。

en.t: The vestments for the seven monks were bestowed according to each monk's rank.

units.source_text: 法服的配色、缝工等等之讲究，均无与伦比。

en.t: The care lavished on the colors, stitching, and every other detail of the vestments was beyond compare.

units.source_text: 这法会中一切排场，都非常庄严。

en.t: Every arrangement for this Buddhist service was extraordinarily solemn and dignified.

units.source_text: 紫夫人不曾郑重其事地和源氏主君商量，因此源氏并未详细指示种种措施。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had not formally discussed the matter with Lord Genji, so Genji did not give detailed instructions for the various arrangements.

units.source_text: 然而这位夫人的计虑十分周至。

en.t: Yet the lady's planning was thoroughly thoughtful and complete.

units.source_text: 源氏见她连佛道也如此深通，觉得此人之慧心不可限量，无任叹佩。

en.t: Seeing that she understood even the Buddhist path so deeply, Genji felt that her spiritual wisdom was beyond measure and admired her profoundly.

units.source_text: 他只在大体上帮办了些事务。

en.t: He merely helped with a few matters in a general way.

units.source_text: 关于乐人、舞人等事，均由夕雾大将负责处理。

en.t: Matters concerning the musicians, dancers, and the like were all handled by General Yugiri.
